---
title: "Reciprocal label-transfer score for the song / non-song pairings (hybrid labels)"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    df-print: paged
---

`song_nonsong_label_transfer_hybrid.qmd` scores the pairings with a **one-directional**
label transfer: song cells as query, non-song cells as reference. This notebook computes
the **reciprocity-weighted** score used by the cross-species integrations in
`snrna/integration/gg_glutonly_hybrid/rpca/`, so the two analyses are scored the same way.

## Why the one-directional score needs this

`TransferData` has no reject option. Every query cell must distribute its vote over the
reference labels, so a query cluster that matches *nothing* well still returns a high score
for whichever reference is nearest. The score measures how concentrated the vote is, not
how good the match is.

`plot_sweep_percluster.py` documents exactly this failure, on this cluster:

> the raw one-directional fwd score can be artifactually high for a genuinely isolated
> query cluster (no reject/novel option in TransferData's vote) -- observed for Glut-RA
> under the manuscript-exact RPCA/SCT config: fwd score 0.968 (highest of any cluster)
> ... the reverse direction shows 374/377 (99%) of its forward-assigned partner's own cells
> vote to Arco clusters, NONE to Glut-RA ... Reciprocity weighting sends Glut-RA's score
> to 0.0.

In the cross-species matrices the song clusters' forward scores (0.14-0.51) collapse to
0.02-0.07 under reciprocity while the non-song clusters hold (Glut-DACH2-6: 0.629 ->
0.635), so the collapse is specific to the clusters this project is about.

## The score, matched to the cross-species code

Per direction, for query cluster *a* and reference label *b*:

```
M[a,b] = frac[a,b] * mean_score[a,b]
```

`frac` = the share of cluster *a*'s cells whose `predicted.id` is *b*; `mean_score` = the
mean of `prediction.score.b` over cluster *a*'s cells. A label that is never the argmax
contributes 0 however much soft probability it carried, which is why these matrices are
sparse and their rows sum to less than 1.

Then, with `fwd` = song query / non-song reference and `rev` = non-song query / song
reference:

```
S[i,j] = sqrt( fwd[i,j] * rev[j,i] )
```

A pairing scores high only if the song type votes for the non-song type **and** that
non-song type's own cells vote back.

**One ambiguity, flagged rather than hidden.** The toolkit that generates the cross-species
matrices (`finch-integration-toolkit`, on the cluster and not in this repo) is the authority
on whether `mean_score` is taken over all of cluster *a*'s cells or only over those assigned
to *b*. Only the docstring's `frac*mean_score` is available here, and both readings fit the
matrices' row sums and sparsity. This notebook uses the mean over **all** of the cluster's
cells; `mean_over_assigned_only` below switches it.

**ARCO is degenerate for this score.** Its only song type is `Glut-CACNA1H-RA`, so the
reverse direction has a single reference label, every non-song cell is forced to vote for
it, and `rev` is identically 1 -- making `S = sqrt(fwd)`, which carries no reciprocal
information. RA's informative reciprocal test is the pooled `ALL` analysis, where the
reverse direction chooses among five song types. ARCO is computed anyway and marked.

# Parameters

```{r params}
sets        = c("ARCO", "NIDO", "ALL")
reductions  = c("pcaproject", "cca")
k_anchors   = c(5, 20)
dims_to_use = 1:30
norm_method = "SCT"
k_weight    = 50

## See the note above: which cells the mean prediction score is taken over.
mean_over_assigned_only = FALSE

song_pattern = "HVC|LMAN|-RA$"

parent_dir = here::here("snrna/integration/song_nonsong_integration_hybrid")
cache_dir  = file.path(parent_dir, "cache")
## the one-directional result, to compare against
fwd_only   = here::here("snrna/integration/song_nonsong_label_transfer_hybrid",
                        "top_partner_label_transfer.csv")

script_name = "song_nonsong_reciprocal_transfer_hybrid"
out_dir  = here::here("snrna/integration", script_name)
rc_cache = file.path(out_dir, "cache")
dir.create(rc_cache, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

n_threads = min(16L, max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 4L))
RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(n_threads)
RcppParallel::setThreadOptions(numThreads = n_threads)
```

# Both directions

```{r transfer-fns}
## One transfer direction, returning the frac * mean_score matrix with query
## clusters as rows and reference labels as columns.
transfer_matrix = function(ref, query, features, reduction, k_anchor, query_labels) {
  ## a single reference label makes the vote trivial (everything scores 1)
  if (n_distinct(ref$celltype) < 2) {
    qt = sort(unique(query_labels))
    m = matrix(1, nrow = length(qt), ncol = 1,
               dimnames = list(qt, unique(ref$celltype)))
    return(list(mat = m, degenerate = TRUE, n_anchors = NA_integer_))
  }

  anchors = FindTransferAnchors(reference = ref, query = query,
                                normalization.method = norm_method,
                                features = features,
                                reduction = reduction, dims = dims_to_use,
                                k.anchor = k_anchor, verbose = FALSE)
  n_anchor_cells = min(dplyr::n_distinct(anchors@anchors[, "cell1"]),
                       dplyr::n_distinct(anchors@anchors[, "cell2"]))
  pred = TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = ref$celltype,
                      weight.reduction = if (reduction == "cca") "cca" else "pcaproject",
                      dims = dims_to_use, k.weight = min(k_weight, n_anchor_cells - 1),
                      verbose = FALSE)

  score_cols = setdiff(grep("^prediction\\.score\\.", colnames(pred), value = TRUE),
                       "prediction.score.max")
  scores = pred[, score_cols, drop = FALSE]
  ref_types = sort(unique(ref$celltype))
  colnames(scores) = ref_types[match(gsub("^prediction\\.score\\.", "", score_cols),
                                     make.names(ref_types))]
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(colnames(scores))))

  long = as_tibble(scores, rownames = "cell") %>%
    mutate(query_type = unname(query_labels[cell]),
           predicted = pred$predicted.id) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(cell, query_type, predicted),
                 names_to = "ref_type", values_to = "score")

  ## frac: share of the query cluster assigned to this reference label
  ## mean_score: mean prediction score for that label, over all of the query
  ## cluster's cells (or only the assigned ones -- see mean_over_assigned_only)
  tab = long %>%
    group_by(query_type, ref_type) %>%
    summarise(frac = mean(predicted == ref_type),
              mean_score = if (mean_over_assigned_only)
                             mean(score[predicted == ref_type]) else mean(score),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mean_score = replace_na(mean_score, 0),
           value = frac * mean_score)

  m = tab %>%
    select(query_type, ref_type, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ref_type, values_from = value) %>%
    column_to_rownames("query_type") %>%
    as.matrix()
  list(mat = m, degenerate = FALSE, n_anchors = nrow(anchors@anchors))
}

reciprocal_one = function(set_name, reduction, k_anchor) {
  key = sprintf("%s_%s_k%02d", set_name, reduction, k_anchor)
  f   = file.path(rc_cache, paste0(key, ".qs2"))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(qs_read(f))
  message("== ", key)

  prep = qs_read(file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("prep_%s.qs2", set_name)), nthreads = 8)
  lab  = prep$labels
  song    = prep$list[["song"]];    song$celltype    = unname(lab[colnames(song)])
  nonsong = prep$list[["nonsong"]]; nonsong$celltype = unname(lab[colnames(nonsong)])

  ## fwd: song cells labelled from the non-song reference
  fwd_res = transfer_matrix(ref = nonsong, query = song, features = prep$features,
                            reduction = reduction, k_anchor = k_anchor,
                            query_labels = setNames(song$celltype, colnames(song)))
  ## rev: non-song cells labelled from the song reference
  ## (named *_res, not fwd/rev: tibble() below creates columns called fwd and rev,
  ## and its sequential evaluation would shadow a local of the same name)
  rev_res = transfer_matrix(ref = song, query = nonsong, features = prep$features,
                            reduction = reduction, k_anchor = k_anchor,
                            query_labels = setNames(nonsong$celltype, colnames(nonsong)))

  song_types    = rownames(fwd_res$mat)
  nonsong_types = colnames(fwd_res$mat)
  Fm = fwd_res$mat[song_types, nonsong_types, drop = FALSE]
  ## rev has non-song clusters as rows and song types as columns; align and
  ## transpose so both are song x non-song before combining
  Rm = matrix(0, nrow = length(song_types), ncol = length(nonsong_types),
              dimnames = list(song_types, nonsong_types))
  shared_rows = intersect(nonsong_types, rownames(rev_res$mat))
  shared_cols = intersect(song_types, colnames(rev_res$mat))
  Rm[shared_cols, shared_rows] = t(rev_res$mat[shared_rows, shared_cols, drop = FALSE])

  S = sqrt(Fm * Rm)
  rev_deg = rev_res$degenerate

  res = tibble(set = set_name, reduction = reduction, k_anchor = k_anchor,
               song_type = rep(song_types, times = length(nonsong_types)),
               nonsong_type = rep(nonsong_types, each = length(song_types)),
               fwd = as.vector(Fm), rev = as.vector(Rm), reciprocal = as.vector(S),
               rev_degenerate = rev_deg)
  qs_save(res, f, nthreads = 4)
  rm(prep, song, nonsong); gc()
  res
}
```

```{r transfer}
#| message: false
grid = expand_grid(set = sets, reduction = reductions, k_anchor = k_anchors)
recip = pmap_dfr(grid, function(set, reduction, k_anchor)
  reciprocal_one(set, reduction, k_anchor))
write_csv(recip, file.path(out_dir, "reciprocal_scores.csv"))

recip %>% count(set, reduction, k_anchor, rev_degenerate, name = "n_cells_in_matrix")
```

# Does the pairing survive reciprocity?

```{r top-recip}
top_recip = recip %>%
  group_by(set, reduction, k_anchor, song_type) %>%
  summarise(top_fwd = nonsong_type[which.max(fwd)],
            fwd_max = max(fwd),
            top_reciprocal = nonsong_type[which.max(reciprocal)],
            reciprocal_max = max(reciprocal),
            ## the reverse score AT the forward-preferred partner: this is the
            ## number that decides whether the forward call was one-directional
            rev_at_fwd_top = rev[which.max(fwd)],
            rev_degenerate = first(rev_degenerate),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(same_partner = top_fwd == top_reciprocal)
write_csv(top_recip, file.path(out_dir, "top_partner_reciprocal.csv"))

top_recip %>%
  filter(!rev_degenerate) %>%
  mutate(across(c(fwd_max, reciprocal_max, rev_at_fwd_top), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  arrange(song_type, reduction, k_anchor)
```

```{r collapse}
## The diagnostic from the cross-species work: how far the score falls when the
## reverse direction is required. A song cluster whose forward call was a
## one-directional artifact collapses; a real pairing holds.
collapse = top_recip %>%
  filter(!rev_degenerate) %>%
  mutate(retained = reciprocal_max / fwd_max) %>%
  group_by(set, song_type) %>%
  summarise(median_fwd = median(fwd_max),
            median_reciprocal = median(reciprocal_max),
            median_retained = median(retained),
            frac_same_partner = mean(same_partner), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(median_retained)
write_csv(collapse, file.path(out_dir, "reciprocity_collapse.csv"))
collapse %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

# Figures

```{r fig-fns}
short = function(x) {
  if_else(grepl(song_pattern, x),
          str_replace(x, "^Glut-(DACH2|CACNA1H)-", ""),
          x %>%
            str_replace("^Glut-DACH2-", "D2-") %>%
            str_replace("^Glut-CACNA1H-", "C1H-") %>%
            str_replace("^Glut-", ""))
}
song_position = function(x) case_when(grepl("LMAN", x) ~ "lman",
                                      grepl("HVC", x)  ~ "hvc",
                                      grepl("RA", x)   ~ "ra",
                                      TRUE             ~ NA_character_)
song_levels = function(x) {
  u = unique(as.character(x))
  rev(u[order(match(song_position(u), c("hvc", "lman", "ra")), u)])
}
## Reading order top to bottom: D2-1..D2-8 then C1H-1..C1H-4 (the y scale below
## passes rev() of this, since the discrete scale puts level 1 at the bottom).
nonsong_levels = function(x) {
  u = unique(as.character(x))
  u[order(match(str_extract(u, "CACNA1H|DACH2"), c("DACH2", "CACNA1H")),
          as.integer(str_extract(u, "[0-9]+$")))]
}

band_cell_in = 0.1

fig_save_gt = function(gt, path_noext, dpi = 600) {
  fig_check_font()
  w = grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  h = grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  ggsave(paste0(path_noext, ".pdf"), gt, width = w, height = h,
         device = cairo_pdf, family = FIG_FONT)
  ggsave(paste0(path_noext, ".png"), gt, width = w, height = h, dpi = dpi,
         bg = FIG_SURFACE, device = ragg::agg_png)
  ggsave(paste0(path_noext, ".svg"), gt, width = w, height = h,
         device = svglite::svglite, bg = FIG_SURFACE)
  invisible(paste0(path_noext, c(".pdf", ".png", ".svg")))
}
```

```{r fig-recip}
#| fig-width: 2.5
#| fig-height: 2.5
#| results: hold
## Same geometry and Blues ramp as the one-directional panels, so the two can be
## compared cell for cell; vmax is each panel's own maximum, as in the
## cross-species heatmaps.
blues = grDevices::colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues"),
                                    space = "rgb")(256)

score_panel = function(d, value_col, bare = FALSE) {
  lv_song = song_levels(d$song_type)
  lv_ns   = nonsong_levels(d$nonsong_type)
  d = d %>% mutate(song_type = factor(as.character(song_type), levels = lv_song),
                   nonsong_type = factor(as.character(nonsong_type), levels = lv_ns),
                   v = .data[[value_col]])
  song_cols = unname(position_colors[song_position(lv_song)])
  vmax = max(d$v, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(vmax) || vmax <= 0) vmax = 1

  p = ggplot(d, aes(song_type, nonsong_type, fill = v)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = blues, limits = c(0, vmax), name = "score",
                         guide = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(0.06, "in"),
                                                 barheight = unit(0.45, "in"),
                                                 title.position = "top")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = short, limits = rev(lv_song), expand = fig_expand(0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = short, limits = rev(lv_ns), expand = fig_expand(0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_fig() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                     colour = rev(song_cols)),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = FIG_PT_AXIS_TEXT),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
  if (bare) p = p + theme(legend.position = "none")

  egg::set_panel_size(p,
                      width  = unit(length(lv_song) * band_cell_in, "in"),
                      height = unit(length(lv_ns) * band_cell_in, "in"))
}

for (st in sets) {
  for (rd in reductions) {
    for (ka in k_anchors) {
      d = filter(recip, set == st, reduction == rd, k_anchor == ka)
      if (!nrow(d)) next
      for (v in c("fwd", "rev", "reciprocal")) {
        gt = score_panel(d, v)
        if (v == "reciprocal") plot(gt)
        stem = sprintf("%s_%s_%s_k%02d", v, tolower(st), rd, ka)
        fig_save_gt(gt, file.path(out_dir, stem))
        fig_save_gt(score_panel(d, v, bare = TRUE), file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, "_bare")))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r fig-collapse}
#| fig-width: 4.5
#| fig-height: 2.2
## Forward vs reciprocal for every song type, the cross-species diagnostic.
p_col = top_recip %>%
  filter(!rev_degenerate) %>%
  mutate(song = short(song_type)) %>%
  select(set, reduction, k_anchor, song, fwd_max, reciprocal_max) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(fwd_max, reciprocal_max), names_to = "score", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(score = recode(score, fwd_max = "one-directional",
                        reciprocal_max = "reciprocal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(score, value, group = interaction(set, reduction, k_anchor, song),
             colour = song)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~set, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(
    unname(position_colors[song_position(sort(unique(top_recip$song_type)))]),
    short(sort(unique(top_recip$song_type)))), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = fig_expand()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "best score",
       title = "Requiring the reverse direction") +
  theme_fig() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = FIG_PT_AXIS_TITLE, colour = FIG_INK_SECONDARY))
print(p_col)
fig_save(p_col, file.path(out_dir, "forward_vs_reciprocal"), width = 4.4, height = 1.9)
```

# Agreement with the one-directional analysis

```{r agreement}
fwd_tab = read_csv(fwd_only, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(set, reduction, k_anchor, song_type, onedir_partner = top_by_score)

cmp = top_recip %>%
  left_join(fwd_tab, by = c("set", "reduction", "k_anchor", "song_type")) %>%
  mutate(agrees = top_reciprocal == onedir_partner)
write_csv(cmp, file.path(out_dir, "comparison_with_onedirectional.csv"))

cmp %>%
  filter(!rev_degenerate) %>%
  group_by(set, song_type) %>%
  summarise(onedir = paste(sort(unique(onedir_partner)), collapse = "/"),
            reciprocal = paste(sort(unique(top_reciprocal)), collapse = "/"),
            frac_agreeing = round(mean(agrees), 3), .groups = "drop")
```
